program:
(rule!
 ;; 2x2 blocks are nodes: the red(2) one is the start, cyan(8) the
 ;; rest. Two nodes connect when axis-aligned with no node between.
 ;; Walk the LONGEST simple path from the start (ties broken by
 ;; direction priority right, down, left, up) and pave orange(7)
 ;; corridors between consecutive nodes.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (block? r c)  ;; top-left corner of a 2x2 block
       (let ((v (at g r c)))
         (and (or (= v 2) (= v 8))
              (= (at g r (+ c 1)) v)
              (= (at g (+ r 1) c) v)
              (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) v)
              (or (zero? r)
                  (not (and (= (at g (- r 1) c) v)
                            (= (at g (- r 1) (+ c 1)) v))))
              (or (zero? c)
                  (not (and (= (at g r (- c 1)) v)
                            (= (at g (+ r 1) (- c 1)) v)))))))
     (define nodes
       (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 1))) (c (range 0 (- w 1)))
                   #:when (block? r c))
         (list r c (at g r c))))
     (define start (find-first (lambda (n) (= (third n) 2)) nodes))
     (define (between? x a b) (and (> x (min a b)) (< x (max a b))))
     (define (adjacent? a b)  ;; same line of sight, nothing between
       (or (and (= (first a) (first b))
                (not (any? (lambda (n)
                             (and (not (equal? n a)) (not (equal? n b))
                                  (= (first n) (first a))
                                  (between? (second n) (second a)
                                            (second b))))
                           nodes)))
           (and (= (second a) (second b))
                (not (any? (lambda (n)
                             (and (not (equal? n a)) (not (equal? n b))
                                  (= (second n) (second a))
                                  (between? (first n) (first a)
                                            (first b))))
                           nodes)))))
     (define (dir-priority a b)  ;; up 0, left 1, down 2, right 3
       (cond ((= (first a) (first b))
              (if (< (second a) (second b)) 3 1))
             ((< (first a) (first b)) 2)
             (else 0)))
     (define (dir-list path)
       (if (or (empty? path) (empty? (rest path)))
           (list)
           (cons (dir-priority (first path) (second path))
                 (dir-list (rest path)))))
     (define (lex-less? xs ys)
       (cond ((empty? xs) #f)
             ((< (first xs) (first ys)) #t)
             ((> (first xs) (first ys)) #f)
             (else (lex-less? (rest xs) (rest ys)))))
     (define (better-path? a b)
       (cond ((> (length a) (length b)) #t)
             ((< (length a) (length b)) #f)
             (else (lex-less? (dir-list a) (dir-list b)))))
     (define (best-path-from current visited)  ;; exhaustive DFS
       (let ((candidates
              (map (lambda (n)
                     (cons current
                           (best-path-from n (cons n visited))))
                   (filter (lambda (n)
                             (and (not (member n visited))
                                  (adjacent? current n)
                                  (not (equal? n current))))
                           nodes))))
         (if (empty? candidates)
             (list current)
             (first (sort candidates better-path?)))))
     (define (corridor out a b)  ;; orange fill between two blocks
       (cond ((= (first a) (first b))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((rr (range (first a) (+ (first a) 2)))
                          (cc (range (+ (min (second a) (second b)) 2)
                                     (max (second a) (second b)))))
                (set-cell acc rr cc 7)))
             ((= (second a) (second b))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((rr (range (+ (min (first a) (first b)) 2)
                                     (max (first a) (first b))))
                          (cc (range (second a) (+ (second a) 2))))
                (set-cell acc rr cc 7)))
             (else out)))
     (let loop ((path (best-path-from start (list start))) (out g))
       (if (or (empty? path) (empty? (rest path)))
           out
           (loop (rest path)
                 (corridor out (first path) (second path))))))))
